tha-ap36:1.1: Kāludāyi.] Padumuttarassa buddhassa lokajeṭṭhassa tādino / aḍḍhānaṃ paṭipannassa carato cārikaṃ tadā, // //
tha-ap36:2.1: Suphullaṃ padumaṃ gayha uppalaṃ mallikañ c' ahaṃ / paramannaṃ gahetvāna adāsiṃ satthuno ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap36:3.1: Paribhuñji mahāvīro paramannaṃ subhojanaṃ / tañ ca pupphaṃ gahetvāna janassa sampadassayi. // //
tha-ap36:4.1: Iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ ciraṃ loke jalajaṃ puppham uttamaṃ / Sudukkaraṃ tena kataṃ yo me puppham adāsi so. // // Yo
tha-ap36:5.1: puppham abhiropesi paramannañ ca 'dāsi me / tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato: // //
tha-ap36:6.1: *Dasa c' aṭṭha ca* kkhattuñ so devarajjaṃ karissati / uppalaṃ padumaṃ cāpi mallikañ ca taduttariṃ. // //
tha-ap36:7.1: Assa puññāvipākena dibbagandhasamāyutaṃ / ākāse chadanaṃ katvā dhārayissati tāvade. // //
tha-ap36:8.1: Pañcavīsatikkhattuñ ca cakkavatti bhavissati / *paṭhavyā rajjaṃ* pañcasataṃ vasudhaṃ āvasissati. // //
tha-ap36:9.1: Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo / Gotamo nāma gottena satthā loke bhavissati. // //
tha-ap36:10.1: Sakakammābhiraddho so sukkamūlena codito / Sakyānaṃ nandijanano ñātibandhu bhavissati. // //
tha-ap36:11.1: So ca pacchā pabbajitvā sukkamūlena codito / sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat' anāsavo. // //
tha-ap36:12.1: Paṭisambhidā c' anuppattam katakiccam anāsavaṃ / Gotamo lokabandhu so etadagge ṭhapessati. // //
tha-ap36:13.1: Padhānaṃ pahitatto so upasanto nirūpadhi / Udāyi nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako. // //
tha-ap36:14.1: Cittañ ca suvimuttam me māno makkho ca dhaṃsito / sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo. // //
tha-ap36:15.1: Tosayiñ cāpi sambuddham ātāpī nipako ahaṃ / pamodito ca sambuddho etadagge ṭhapesi maṃ. // //
tha-ap36:16.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap36:17.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Kāludāyi thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
